budget_items.what_was_recorded: A little over $211,000 of the $4 million contingency funding has been expended.
budget_items.quote: a little over $211,000 of the $4 million contingency funding has been expended.

budget_items.topic: Contingency items ruled ineligible by bond counsel
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three items judged ineligible by bond counsel, totalling roughly $2 million, were removed from the contingency list.
budget_items.quote: these items, totalling roughly $2 million, have been removed from the contingency list.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Powell Stone and Gravel would donate labor and materials, reducing the cost of the outdoor study area from $48,000 to $10,800 if approved by the SBC.
budget_items.quote: reducing the cost from $48,000 to $10,800.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Relocating and digitally reproducing existing murals is an item costing approximately $15,000.
budget_items.quote: this item costs approximately $15,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Construction of a maintenance garage was originally in project scope at $185,000 and was removed in value engineering; it may be assumed within contingency.
budget_items.quote: construction of a maintenance garage ($185,000) was originally planned within the project scope.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A touchscreen monitor for athletic archives is an item costing about $24,000.
budget_items.quote: this item costs about $24,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A digital exterior sign for school and town news and emergency updates is a placeholder on the contingency list at $58,000.
budget_items.quote: a digital exterior sign costing $58,000, for school and town news and emergency updates

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Additional cooling to classroom wings was removed in value engineering; its cost was stated as $500,000.
budget_items.quote: modifying the air at the cost of $500,000.

budget_items.topic: Artificial turf for two new athletic fields
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Artificial turf for the new stadium field and practice field was listed at $1 million; Ms. Bertram raised concern about turf maintenance cost.
budget_items.quote: artificial turf for 2 new athletic fields; the new stadium field and the new practice field ($1 million).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Reconfiguration of the parking lot is requested at $250,000 and has not been designed yet.
budget_items.quote: reconfiguration of the parking lot is also requested ($250,000), but it hasn't been designed yet.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The existing turf field must be replaced at a cost of over $1 million.
budget_items.quote: the existing turf field has to be replaced at the cost of over $1 million.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The MSBA set a cap of $275/square foot or an 8% site cap, which the project was already over.
budget_items.quote: the msba set a cap of $275/square foot or an 8% site cap.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The local share moved from $36,784,451 in January 2014 to $38,192,941 in November 2015; the project funding agreement set the higher figure.
budget_items.quote: ms. luck asked about the local share listed in january 2014, it was $36,784,451. when she looked at the november 2015 share, it is $38,192,941.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The MSBA requires the full project amount of $72 million to be appropriated before reimbursement.
budget_items.quote: the msba requires you to appropriate the full project amount, $72 million and then be reimbursed for expenses.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The project has a construction contingency of 5% and a project contingency of 1%.
budget_items.quote: there is a construction contingency (5%) and a project contingency (1%).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Ebersole asked for a cost comparison of turf versus sod; no figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: mr. ebersole stated he would like to see a cost comparison of turf versus sod.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bond financing of the sewer project through the Massachusetts Clean Water Trust was approved in the amount of $1,521,653.
budget_items.quote: in the amount of $1,521,653 on a water pollution abatement bond.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A one-year BAN of $841,518 at 0.75 percent covers the Lane Property, a fire truck, and DPW equipment.
budget_items.quote: the bond anticipation note (ban) in the amount of $841,518.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager set aside $40,000 for storm water projects and hopes to set aside another $40,000 for FY 2017.
budget_items.quote: the town manager has set aside $40,000 for storm water projects and will hopefully set aside another $40,000 for fy 2017.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed accounts payable warrants of $165,616.18 and $2,116,766.41.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable in the amount of $165,616.18 and another in the amount of $2,116,766.41.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Mackin believed the project would end by returning some of the funding.
budget_items.quote: at the end of the day he believed they would be returning some of the funding.
